prefill.name: Prefill
prefill.notes: Default mode records the required decode scout request for each non-zero decode context, so normal runs do not pay for a separate prefill phase. Standalone mode repeats cold-prefill samples. Prometheus prefill counters, when available and uncontaminated, are stored as validation.

sustained_decode.name: Sustained Decode
sustained_decode.formula: OpenAI stream usage completion_tokens per measured window; client chunk fallback only when continuous usage is unavailable
sustained_decode.notes: Duration-based steady-state cell after warmup. This is the main tuning/regression signal for kernels, NCCL, DCP, MTP, and scheduling. Prometheus metrics are stored as validation and scheduler state, not the default headline.

burst_e2e_decode.name: Burst / E2E Decode
burst_e2e_decode.notes: Finite client-facing request burst using OpenAI stream usage. It includes request admission, scheduling, prefill/cache behavior, and completion.
